summary: Category-Based Dynamic Commission Module tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/16 commission-module tests pass; the ONLY failure is the EXACT error-message format — backend returns 'between 5.0% and 20.0%' (float) while the PRD template and the frontend client-side validator both use integer form 'between 5% and 20%'. This creates a UX mismatch (client and server show different messages) and technically violates the PRD 'exact match' clause. Frontend /admin/categories and /admin/products render correctly: banner, range column with bar, +Add Category modal with min/max, client-side min>max rejection, +Add Product modal shows allowed range hint dynamically per category, out-of-range values are blocked client-side with the exact PRD message, quick-pick chips work, OOR toolbar counter renders. Regression: 24/26 Phase 1 tests still pass; the 2 failing (test_order_pricing, test_free_delivery_threshold) are ENVIRONMENT DRIFT — business_rules were manually changed by earlier UI activity (delivery_charge=25, free_delivery_above=999, min_order_amount=199 instead of 30/499/99). No code regression; tests were written against seed defaults. Business Rules PATCH bug from iteration_1 is FIXED (test_get_and_patch_and_effect now passes).

minor.issue: Error message formats commission bounds as float ('5.0%' / '20.0%') because `min_commission` / `max_commission` are stored as Python float. PRD template says 'X%' (implicitly integer for whole numbers) and the frontend already renders 'between 5% and 20%' client-side. Fix: in catalog_routes.py _validate_product_commission, format as: `lo_s = int(lo) if lo == int(lo) else lo` (same for hi) so the message reads 'between 5% and 20% for Groceries category.' Alternatively, always use int(round(...)) if you only support whole-percent policy. Reference: /app/backend/routes/catalog_routes.py:49.

Per-line commission works correctly (verified qty=30 * ₹10 * 7% = 21.0). No bug — noted only that global rules.commission_percent is retained as a FALLBACK when a product row is missing commission_percentage (line 78 of order_routes.py). This is defensive but harmless.

ui_bugs.issue: Client-side validation message hard-codes integer format via `${cat.min_commission}%` (line 158), which is fine, but backend returns float form. UI users see one message client-side and a different one on server-error toast (backend rejects patch when local check is bypassed). Recommend fixing the backend format (see backend/minor above) OR aligning client to also emit float form — but PRD asks integer form, so fix on backend.

issues: Rendered client error text shows a double space between category name and 'category.' — 'for Cloth  category.' (see screenshot /tmp/products_modal.png). Likely a whitespace normalization artefact but visually noticeable.

test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_neds_phase1.py (updated to include commission_percentage on product creates)
action_items: BACKEND FIX (minor): In /app/backend/routes/catalog_routes.py _validate_product_commission, format lo/hi as integer when whole. E.g.: `lo_disp = int(lo) if float(lo).is_integer() else lo; hi_disp = int(hi) if float(hi).is_integer() else hi` and use in the error `detail`. This aligns backend with PRD 'exact match' and with the frontend client-side message.

FRONTEND POLISH: Verify no double space appears in the client-side error string on /admin/products (screenshot showed 'for Cloth  category.'). Likely from an extra space in JSX template — inspect line 158 of products.tsx.

ENVIRONMENT: business_rules row in Mongo has drifted from seed defaults (delivery_charge=25, free_delivery_above=999, min_order_amount=199, verification_radius_meters=100). This is a byproduct of prior UI edits, NOT a bug. If desired, main agent can reset via `PATCH /api/business-rules` to restore Phase 1 default numeric expectations, or the phase1 tests can be updated to read current rules dynamically.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog_routes.py _validate_product_commission: uses cat.get('min_commission', 0) / max 100 as defaults — good for pre-existing categories missing fields, but the seed backfill already sets 5/20 so defaults rarely trigger.
seed.py seed_categories: backfill only sets min/max when field is missing; user-changed values are preserved on restart — matches the idempotency requirement.

order_routes.py create_order: correctly uses product's commission_percentage per line and falls back to rules.commission_percent only when the product is missing — fallback should probably log a warning to surface stale carts.

models.py CategoryUpdate: min_commission/max_commission accept None but no field validator for 0..100 — the route calls _validate_range which enforces this, so it's fine, but adding a Pydantic bound would give 422 instead of 400 on API misuse.
products.tsx buildQuickPicks: generates picks with 1-decimal rounding, but the client-side error string uses integer form — cosmetic-only when picks are non-integer (e.g., 12.5%).

rca_of_issue: Exact-message mismatch RCA: Category min/max are stored as Python floats in Mongo (seed writes 5.0, 20.0). The error string uses f'{lo}% and {hi}%' which stringifies floats with trailing .0. PRD template and frontend client-side error both use integer form. Reproduction: POST /api/products with commission_percentage=5 to a category whose range is 10-20 → detail = 'Commission must be between 10.0% and 20.0% for X category.' Expected: 'between 10% and 20%'. Mitigation: format integer when whole, else keep the float representation. One-line fix suggested in action_items.
